nodes.label: ConsumerEgressRoutePolicy
nodes.responsibility: For one declared consumer, route only admitted destination/port pairs through the existing shared HTTP carrier; preserve terminal rejection of undeclared outbound effects, independent of HTTP CONNECT success text.
nodes.authority: Network consumer-specific sing-box policy (not provider or application authority)
inputs: Selected consumer identity; bounded destination/port; source-qualified consumer egress.json and shared provider-carrier endpoint.

behavioralContract: For the x-reality and supply-chain source policies, allowed destinations and exact port may forward through the shared carrier; unlisted destinations and wrong ports must not reach upstream. A CONNECT 200 or curl failure is not itself an upstream no-forwarding witness.

nodes.label: ConsumerReadinessVerdict
nodes.responsibility: Compute a bounded, consumer-local READY/non-READY decision from current proxy endpoint/allowed-origin observations with one shared retry deadline.
nodes.authority: Network readiness observation for a named consumer; not the effect provider
inputs: Named consumer readiness script, current process/socket/proxy observation, upstream probe result, finite deadline.
outputs: A source-local readiness verdict; nonzero/UNKNOWN when necessary observation is missing, failed or expired.
behavioralContract: One upstream loss cannot multiply retry windows across origins; an arbitrary curl/HTTP error, status from wrong origin, or proxy-auth failure cannot upgrade to READY.
A conservative CONNECT403 signature can yield false-negative readiness for some actual sing-box reject policies; live provider/domain success is not entailed.
acceptance: Native isolated Bash fake-time test demonstrates a common failure consumes one shared deadline and cannot yield READY.
Native negative transport/origin/proxy-auth cases reject false READY; installed readiness and true upstream observation require additional receipts.

Current supply-chain/ready.sh only emits READY when same-attempt proxy CONNECT=403 is observed. That is a conservative source-path sufficient check, NOT a necessary/provider-general meaning of policy rejection: installed sing-box can reject after CONNECT=200 and TLS reset without forwarding. Arbitrary curl failure, 407, 000, or origin HTTP403 remains insufficient.

Before admitting another native denial signature to READY, bind the exact loaded proxy policy and an independent upstream no-forwarding witness to the same source, destination and attempt. No generic curl35/HTTP000 or HTTP CONNECT alone is an allowed authority.
